description: This source file defines an Express.js router for handling CRUD operations on LLM cost records. It sets up routes for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting records, with tenant enforcement middleware, header-based tenant resolution, and Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: router.use
methods.description: Applies middleware functions verifyAuth, requireTenant, tenantScopeEnforcer, and a custom middleware for setting tenant headers and model collection info.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing LLM cost records, supporting filtering, sorting, pagination, and tenant scoping.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LLM cost record by its ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Creates a new LLM cost record, with tenant scope enforced.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Updates an existing LLM cost record by ID, tenant scope enforced.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Deletes an LLM cost record by ID, with tenant enforcement.
